author: ballzi
body:
Hello my name is ballzi. I am looking for a team that is non spammy on skype. Scrims are on a regular basis.


Pros: I click fast ranging from 7cps and more. I can jitter and my combos are deadly. I have been known to take out iron guys :3. I am a somewhat good rusher, observing my surrounding before I rush in. I have scrimmage experiences.

Cons: My ping to avicus isn't the best. I am not very good at bow and arrow ;c. I can't take on more that 3 players.

Hopefully someone accepts me! I would be glad to join a team!

Skype: Brandon.lao87
